raw_state_rotation: extrinsic Euler xyz, radians (inferred from trajectory continuity and downward EEF orientation)
runtime_rotation_conversion: canonical_axis_angle on existing RLinf wrapper output; must be integrated at step 5
action_frame: robot root frame; rotation delta left-multiplies current orientation

cameras.calibration_provenance: fixed IsaacLab task config; public dataset does not contain capture-time calibration

tail_padding: repeat final action for explicit boundary probes; official training drops final 15 start frames even with allow_padding=true
statistics: computed from 117 train episodes after explicit state conversion; reused for validation/test
success_provenance: public demonstrations; dataset has no per-episode success flag
video_codec: mpeg4 (MPEG-4 Part 2); source meta/info.json incorrectly declares av1
